name: Inaka Ecchi
source:
When you think of the countryside, do you think of sex?

Summertime. Taiga-kun walks along a mountain stream,
where he meets two girls playing in the water. Nude.

Enjoy a "private" outdoor encounter of youth in idyllic rural Japan! 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE166375.html]DLsite English[/url]]

想到乡下，你会想到性吗？

盛夏，泰加沿着山间溪流散步，遇见两个正在水中玩耍的女孩。她们一丝不挂。

在风景如画的日本乡村，享受一场“私密”的青春户外邂逅！
